d:
Someone begins sending mischievous text messages under Popatlal's name to various Gokuldham Society members. Anjali is told Taarak Mehta is binging on street food, Roshan thinks Sodhi is partying instead of working, Babita believes Iyer lost his job, Madhavi suspects Bhide is hiding secrets, and Daya is told Sunderlal is arriving in Mumbai.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
